comparison.objective: Remove a pinned anti-theft tag using a magnetic detacher.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise detacher registration, latch release, pin extraction and withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Detacher correctly seated during release, pin fully removed, both grippers clear and still for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests keyed unlatching and extraction, not loose-body dynamics or screening.
